title: Brock Wagner
summary: Rice 1987 graduate (economics and managerial studies) who spent six years in investment banking, then started building Houston's Saint Arnold Brewing Company in 1993; Rice News profiled him in 2024 for 30 years as a craft beer pioneer, and he told the Rice Thresher he is still very involved at Rice. No personal angel investments were found.
why_relevant: Rice alumnus who built Houston's best-known beverage brand; a credible advisor and door-opener to Texas beverage distribution, even if not a check writer.

details.rice_connection: Rice '87, economics and managerial studies (Rice News)
details.contact_path: Rice alumni network or Rice Alliance for a warm intro; Saint Arnold Brewing (Houston)

title: Ryan Baird
summary: Co-founded Yellow Rose Distilling, Houston's first legal whiskey distillery (founded 2010, first product 2012), while completing his Rice MBA; Rice Magazine (2018) names him and Randy Whitaker as Rice class of 2012 and says Baird was previously an engineer. CB Insights lists him as founding partner (may be dated). No angel investing evidence found.
why_relevant: Rice MBA alumnus who built a Houston beverage brand from scratch; a peer advisor on Texas beverage distribution and local investors.

details.contact_path: Rice Business alumni network; Yellow Rose Distilling (Houston)

title: Randy Whitaker
summary: Co-founded Yellow Rose Distilling, Houston's first legal whiskey distillery, with Ryan Baird while both completed Rice MBAs (class of 2012); Rice Magazine (2018) says he was previously a CPA. His current role is unverified and no angel investing evidence was found.
why_relevant: Second Rice MBA beverage founder from the same company; contact one Yellow Rose founder at a time.

details.contact_path: Rice Business alumni network; Yellow Rose Distilling (Houston)

title: Delaney Berman
summary: Founded Berman Foods, a plant-based cheese food and beverage CPG brand, while in Rice's Jones MBA program; Poets&Quants named it one of 2022's most disruptive MBA startups, and a Rice Business feature described her plan to keep running it as founder and CEO after graduating. A founder peer, not an investor.
why_relevant: Rice-network food CPG founder who can share investor, co-packer and retail contacts with another early brand.

details.rice_connection: Rice MBA (Jones) student/candidate per Rice Business and Poets&Quants (graduation not confirmed)
details.contact_path: Rice Business community; Rice Business feature on Berman Foods

title: Jessica Fleenor
summary: Named managing director of BlueLaunch when the Rice Alliance launched it in May 2022 as Rice's accelerator for consumer product companies and other small businesses, offering mentorship plus legal, financial, sales and marketing resources. Her current role and any personal investing are unverified.
why_relevant: Gatekeeper to Rice's consumer-product accelerator and its mentor network, a natural route for a Rice-tied CPG brand.

details.rice_connection: Managing director of BlueLaunch, a Rice Alliance accelerator (2022)
details.contact_path: Rice Alliance BlueLaunch accelerator (apply, or ask the Rice Alliance team for an intro)

title: Coco Seney
summary: Director of Strategic Partnerships at Rice Business; her profile cites partnerships across Fortune 500s, startups and consumer brands, including work on a Molson Coors product and with natural food startups at the Kraft Heinz Springboard incubator. No personal investing evidence found.
why_relevant: Rice insider with beverage and natural-food corporate ties who can route a CPG founder to the right Rice and industry contacts.

details.firm: Rice Business (Jones Graduate School of Business)
details.rice_connection: Rice Business staff (Director of Strategic Partnerships); alumni status not stated
details.contact_path: Rice Business strategic partnerships office (public faculty/staff profile)
